cohort: Patients aged 18-40 years who gave birth at Ankara Koru Hospital between January 1, 2019, and January 1, 2022 (n=189; 57 TOLACs, 72 vaginal deliveries, and 60 elective caesarean sections)
finding: The study found that the main reason for not preferring TOLAC is the risk of uterine rupture, and recommends that TOLAC can be recommended to eligible patients in tertiary centers.
mod_finding: Even when excluding factors that increase the success of VBAC, the rate of successful VBAC remained high.
